dogecoin.text: Made the mistake of thinking that $bch would be faster than $btc to transfer... almost the same time. It's cheaper, but that's about it. Wish every exchange supported $doge, insanely fast transfers and the cheapest price in town to get money from one part to another.

What's the most useful crypto for you?! One that I use a lot is $doge since it's the cheapest out there to transfer from on exchange to another.... wish it did more than just being so ridiculously cheap to transfer!
